Container.Name: neutronsync
Container.Overview: NeutronSync keeps local folders and Proton Drive in sync. This container runs the headless engine and the browser interface. Set NEUTRONSYNC_WEB_PASSWORD on first start. Narrow the /data path to the shares you sync.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Config, state, encrypted session, web login data and logs

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Default local root for folder pairs. Narrow this to the shares you sync instead of the whole array.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id that owns files under /config

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id that owns files under /config

Config.Name: Web Password
Config.Description: Required on first start. At least 12 characters. Protects the web login.

Config.Name: Session Key
Config.Description: Optional. 32-byte key (base64) for the encrypted Proton session. Pass this separately from /config so a copied appdata folder alone cannot decrypt the session.
